# TorBox Go SDK

Go client for the [TorBox API](https://api-docs.torbox.app). Generated from the
[OpenAPI spec](https://api.torbox.app/openapi.json) and published automatically when the API changes.

```bash
go get github.com/TorBox-App/torbox-sdk-go/v9@v9.3.1-20261125.4
```

## Quick start

```go
import torbox "github.com/TorBox-App/torbox-sdk-go/v9"

c := torbox.New(os.Getenv("TORBOX_API_KEY"))  // https://torbox.app/settings
me, err := torbox.Result(c.UserAPI.GetUserData(ctx).Execute())
if err != nil { return err }
data := me.GetData()
fmt.Println(data.GetEmail())

f, _ := os.Open("ubuntu.torrent")
_, err = torbox.Result(c.TorrentsAPI.CreateTorrent(ctx).File(f).Execute())
```

API groups are fields of the client: `TorrentsAPI`, `UsenetAPI`, `WebDownloadsAPI`, `UserAPI`, `GeneralAPI`,
`NotificationsAPI`, `RssAPI`, `IntegrationsAPI`, `QueuedAPI`, `StreamAPI`, `TagsAPI`, `AssistantAPI`, `VendorsAPI`.
Method names are the `operationId`s of the [reference](https://api-docs.torbox.app/reference); `docs/` lists them.

## Authentication

`New` sends the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The download link endpoints take it as the `token` parameter:

```go
link, err := torbox.Result(c.TorrentsAPI.RequestTorrentDownloadLink(ctx).Token(c.APIKey()).TorrentId(123).FileId(0).Execute())
```

## Pagination

```go
for offset := int64(0); ; offset += 100 {
	page, err := torbox.Result(c.TorrentsAPI.GetTorrentList(ctx).Offset(offset).Limit(100).Execute())
	if err != nil { return err }
	items := page.GetData() // see docs/ for the type
	// ...
	if len(items) < 100 { break }
}
```

## Errors

`torbox.Result` checks the `{success, error, detail, data}` envelope: error statuses and `success:false` become
`*torbox.Error`.

```go
var apiErr *torbox.Error
if errors.As(err, &apiErr) {
	log.Println(apiErr.Status, apiErr.Code, apiErr.Detail) // 403 PLAN_RESTRICTED_FEATURE ...
}
```

Request validation errors (`422`) have `Code == "VALIDATION_ERROR"`. Error codes:
[api-docs.torbox.app/docs/errors](https://api-docs.torbox.app/docs/errors).

## Retries and timeouts

`429` and `503` are retried (default 3 times), waiting for `Retry-After` or backing off exponentially. Each attempt
times out after 30 s; use the `ctx` for a per-call deadline.

```go
c := torbox.New(key, torbox.Options{Timeout: 10 * time.Second, MaxRetries: 5, BaseURL: "https://api.torbox.app"})
```
